cases.sentence: По великой Своей любви прости грех этого народа, как прощал ему со времен Египта до ___.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

cases.sentence: Раз в долинах живут амаликитяне и хананеи, поверните завтра и ступайте в пустыню к ___.
cases.explain: «Красному морю» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

cases.sentence: — Сколько еще этот ___ будет роптать на Меня?
cases.explain: «грешный народ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

cases.sentence: Я непременно сделаю так с этим ___, который восстал против Меня.
cases.explain: «грешным народом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

cases.sentence: Но они дерзнули подняться к вершинам нагорий, хотя ни ковчег ___, ни Моисей не покидали лагерь .
cases.explain: «Господнего завета» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.
